description.value: An Australian Centrelink Customer Reference Number (also referred to as unique identifier number (UIN) is used in the Centrelink Confirmation eServices (CCeS)). An identifier assigned to an individual by Centrelink for the purposes of identifying people (and organisations) eligible for specific services, including some public health care services, such as oral health services. This number may appear on a Health Care Card, Commonwealth Seniors Health Card, or Pensioner Concession Card. Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).
